(d) षट् काण्डानि as two words is right: a numeral adjective with its noun, parallel to पञ्च सर्गशतान्; it re-joins without change, and a dvigu would be neuter singular (षट्काण्डी/षट्काण्डम्), not plural. Not errors: the numeral glosses पञ्चसङ्ख्याकान् / षट्सङ्ख्याकानि are longer than the word (the pilot glossed पञ्च (जनान्)); the short ārṣa clause in the vyākhyā explains a hard form where it is used (rule 4), not a remark on the verse.

VR.1.4.3.note: Second pass: the artha and fit_note now give प्रयुञ्जीत (1.3.64) as the regular form. check_layers OK. First pass: प्रयुञ्जीयात् is rightly called ārṣa, but the regular form is given wrongly. युज् is उभयपदी, and with प्र it is ātmanepada by प्रोपाभ्यां युजेरयज्ञपात्रेषु (1.3.64); so the regular विधिलिङ् is प्रयुञ्जीत, not the parasmaipada प्रयुञ्ज्यात्. The printed form mixes the ātmanepada ई (सीयुट्) with the parasmaipada यात् (यासुट्). Rest clean: स-भविष्यम्, सह-उत्तरम् are both bahuvrīhis (tulyayoga) with anvita तत्; नु as प्रश्नार्थकम् अव्ययम्; one gerund; चिन्तयामास agrees with वाल्मीकिः.

VR.1.4.4.note: Second pass: the genitive is now the possessor of पादौ; the anvaya is 'ततः मुनिवेषौ कुशीलवौ चिन्तयमानस्य भावितात्मनः तस्य महर्षेः पादौ अगृह्णीताम्', with no supplied (सतः)/(तस्य). First pass: Judged: 'भावलक्षणे षष्ठी' is not a valid label. यस्य च भावेन भावलक्षणम् (2.3.37) gives the सप्तमी; the षष्ठी is allowed only in disregard, षष्ठी चानादरे (2.3.38), and there is no disregard here: the boys bow to the sage. There is also no need for an absolute. तस्य … महर्षेः भावितात्मनः is simply the possessor of पादौ (सम्बन्धे षष्ठी), and चिन्तयमानस्य is its attribute ('the feet of the sage, who was thinking'). The anvaya must then stop supplying (सतः) and a second (तस्य). The vyākhyā keeps its present participle and its one इत्युक्ते. Rest clean: अगृह्णीताम् ग्रह् लङ् प्रथम द्वि; धारयन्तौ, अगृह्णीताम्, प्रणेमतुः agree with the dual कुशीलवौ; कुशीलवौ has the names.json identifier at first use. If the coordinator prefers an absolute reading, the label must be अनादरे षष्ठी (2.3.38), but disregard does not fit the scene.

Optional: add 'anvita': 'आख्यानम्' to विचित्र-अर्थ-पदम्.

VR.1.4.34.note: Three-line verse; daṇḍas as printed. तन्त्री-लयवत् as matup neuter accusative (fit_note-free 'not in word list' warning only) is defensible; the वति-avyaya reading 'like the rhythm of the strings' would be the other one, no change of sense. ह्लादयत् neuter nominative with गेयम्, objects in द्वितीया right. Vyākhyā: प्रेरितौ … अगायताम्, ज्ञायते स्म, उच्यते, बभौ all agree. One इत्युक्ते.

VR.1.4.35.note: Second pass. The agreement fix is applied: the vyākhyā now reads 'इमौ यत् चरितं **प्रचक्षाते**, कथयतः' (dual, right). The padārtha and anvaya keep the verse's own form प्रचक्षते with the ārṣa label, which is correct for that reading. check_layers OK. Still for a human (the reading choice only): ārṣa plural for the dual with इमौ as subject (the draft's), or the generic plural '(मुनयः/वृद्धाः) तत् मम अपि भूतिकरं प्रचक्षते' with no ārṣa. If the second is chosen, use: padārtha artha 'कथयन्ति (मुनयः)' without the ārṣa label; anvaya '(हे भ्रातरः सभासदः च,) इमौ मुनी कुशीलवौ पार्थिवलक्षणान्वितौ महातपस्विनौ च एव (स्तः) । तत् (चरितं) मम अपि भूतिकरं (इति मुनयः) प्रचक्षते ; (यूयं) महानुभावं चरितं निबोधत ।'; vyākhyā sentence 4 'इमौ यत् **चरितं** गायतः, **तत्** **मम** **अपि** **भूतिकरम्** इति मुनयः **प्रचक्षते**, यतः तत् कल्याणं समृद्धिं च करोति ।'

VR.1.4.36.note: Padaccheda right: the printed line-breaks प्रचोदिता-/वगायतां and शनै-/र्बुभूषया are re-assigned to whole words and re-join; रामवचः प्रचोदितौ, printed with a space, is correctly taken as one compound (रामवचः could not stand alone here). मार्ग as the classical (मार्ग, not देशी) style of singing, glossed शास्त्रीयं गानम्, is right and enough. Agreement: तौ … प्रचोदितौ … अगायताम्, गीतवन्तौ (dual), सः … आसीत्/बभूव (sg) right. For a human: बुभूषया. The draft commits to 'श्रोतृभिः सह कथायां मग्नः भवितुम् इच्छया', which the verse does not say. The readings to choose from: (a) the commentarial one, as far as I recall it (not checked; no network): desire to be one of the audience, i.e. Rāma left the throne and joined the assembly as a listener; शनैः then goes with परिषद्गतः ('slowly came down into the assembly'); (b) desire for prosperity (बुभूषा = भवितुम्/भूतिम् इच्छा; cf. भूतिकरम् in 35); (c) the draft's. Suggested wording for (a): gloss 'श्रोतृषु एकः भवितुम् इच्छया'; vyākhyā sentences 2–3 '**सः** **च** **अपि** **रामः** श्रोतृषु एकः भवितुम् इच्छति स्म ; तया **बुभूषया** सः **शनैः** सिंहासनात् अवरुह्य **परिषद्गतः**, सभायां सर्वैः सह उपविष्टः, अभवत् । ततः सः तस्मिन् गाने **आसक्तमनाः** **बभूव** **ह**, तस्य मनः गाने लग्नम् अभवत् ।' (सिंहासनात् अवरुह्य is commentarial; drop it if the human prefers nothing beyond the verse).
